memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Patient reports occasional fatigue, increased thirst and mild polyuria over the past month. Examination shows BMI 28 kg/m2, blood pressure 128/82 mmHg, random capillary glucose 162 mg/dL. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Metformin 500 mg twice daily; Glimepiride 1 mg once daily before breakfast; Sitagliptin 100 mg once daily; Empagliflozin 10 mg once daily. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.8% (ref 4.0-5.6); Fasting plasma glucose 138 mg/dL (ref 70-99); Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 22 mg/g (ref <30).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Patient notes improved energy but occasional post‑prandial thirst. Examination: weight 70 kg, BMI 27.5, BP 126/80, random glucose 148 mg/dL. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Metformin increased to 850 mg twice daily; Glimepiride 1 mg once daily before breakfast; Sitagliptin 100 mg once daily; Empagliflozin 10 mg once daily. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.2% (ref 4.0-5.6); Fasting plasma glucose 124 mg/dL (ref 70-99); Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 18 mg/g (ref <30).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Dilated fundus exam: mild microaneurysms scattered temporally, no macular edema, no hemorrhages. Recommend annual repeat.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling a bit more tired lately and notice my feet are slightly swollen by evening. My blood sugar checks at home have been around 150‑170 mg/dL before meals.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-11-10 at 10:30 am with Dr Suresh Menon (D05) for diabetes review.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Patient reports mild fatigue and evening foot swelling; home glucose 150‑170 mg/dL. Examination: weight 71 kg, BMI 27.8, BP 130/82, trace pedal edema. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Add Sitagliptin 100 mg once daily (already on); increase Empagliflozin to 25 mg once daily. Continue Metformin 850 mg BD, Glimepiride 1 mg OD. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 6.6% (ref 4.0-5.6); Fasting plasma glucose 108 mg/dL (ref 70-99); Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 12 mg/g (ref <30).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Dr Priya Nair, Endocrinology, Vikram Hospital for optimisation of diabetes management and consideration of GLP‑1 therapy. Include recent labs and fundus report.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Endocrinology review: patient tolerates current regimen; HbA1c 6.6% acceptable. Advised to continue metformin, empagliflozin, glimepiride; add low‑dose GLP‑1 RA if further intensification needed. Return to primary care for routine follow‑up.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Patient feels well, no polyuria or fatigue; home glucose 95‑115 mg/dL fasting. Examination: weight 70 kg, BMI 27.2, BP 124/78, no edema. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0. HbA1c 6.5% from recent lab.
